## What This Experiment Tests

Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `vector_two_broad` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Baseline 2D multimodal vector task with two broad isotropic Gaussians at (-1, 0) and (+1, 0) (sigma=0.25), checking basic multimodal coverage, balanced mass, and accurate within-mode spread.

> [!NOTE]
> **Protocol notes:** Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `vector_two_broad` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.

## Laws & Edge Cases Targeted

- **[Law 1: Representational Geometry](../LAWS_HUB.md#law1)** ([Law 1 theory](../../../docs/four-laws.md#law-1--representational-geometry)) — Can the system represent the required probability measure efficiently and faithfully?
- **[Law 2: Potential Geometry](../LAWS_HUB.md#law2)** ([Law 2 theory](../../../docs/four-laws.md#law-2--potential-geometry)) — Does the critic communicate useful learning forces with appropriate geometric control and computational efficiency?
- **Edge-case tags:** `broad-modes`, `covariance-calibration`, `legacy-prior-cohort`
